overview.lead: Global capability building and startup acceleration, from Silicon Valley
paragraphs: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Odyssey Ventures, LLC was founded in 2018 as a specialist in capability-building education for global markets and startup acceleration. We design and run hands-on education programs for public institutions, startups and universities, along with acceleration programs that help startups expand globally, providing practical and structured solutions for entering overseas markets and strengthening global competitiveness.

Odyssey Ventures launched its startup acceleration business in earnest in 2024. Building on our founder's and team's years of experience mentoring and growing startups, and on our wide network across Silicon Valley, we run both partner programs and our own programs.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.description: Common questions about our services, registration, payment and accounts.
faqPage.empty: No results. Try other words or ask Customer Support.
faqPage.moreText: Leave a private question in Customer Support and the Odyssey Ventures team will reply.

items.a: A global capability training, consulting and startup acceleration company headquartered in Silicon Valley (San Jose, California). Founded in 2018, we help startups and companies build the product, sales and fundraising capabilities they need in global markets.

Four: Academy (courses and webinars), 1:1 Advisory (one-on-one expert advisory), Accelerator (a complete U.S. market entry program) and Consulting (sales and fundraising consulting for companies). See Services in the top menu for each.

items.q: Can companies based in Korea use your services?
items.a: Yes. Academy sessions run online on Zoom or Google Meet, and we run programs for Korean startups and organizations.

items.q: How do I register for a session?
items.a: Choose a session on the Academy page and fill in the form on its page. We confirm by email and send the joining link before the session.
It depends on the session. Any fee is shown on the session page and in our emails.

items.q: I didn't get the joining link.
items.a: We send it to your registration email before the session. Check your spam folder, and if it isn't there, contact Customer Support.
Send a request; our team reviews it and matches an expert from our advisory board. After we share the fee and you pay, we schedule your one-on-one session.

items.q: Am I charged when I submit a request?
items.a: No. Requests are free. We share the fee after reviewing your request and matching an expert, and payment comes after that.

items.q: What areas can I get advice on?
items.a: Global market entry strategy (product, go-to-market, fundraising, IR, setting up a U.S. entity) and settling and operating in the U.S. (legal, finance, accounting and tax, sales and marketing, HR). The advisory board is listed on the 1:1 Advisory page.
It depends on the track: startups with Seed or TIPS funding, startups with Pre-A or Series A funding or later, and schools and government or startup support organizations.

items.q: Can our organization run a program with you?
items.a: Yes. We run programs with government agencies, companies and schools. Use the form on the Accelerator page to reach us.

items.q: How is Consulting different from 1:1 Advisory?
items.a: 1:1 Advisory is a per-request, one-on-one session with an expert on a specific issue. Consulting is a project we run with your company, from sales to VC fundraising.
After we review your request, we email you the amount and how to pay.
Refund terms will be published here and in our emails as they are finalized for each service. For your specific case, please contact Customer Support.
No account is needed to register for sessions or request advisory. You sign in with your email only to use Customer Support or comment in the Newsroom.

items.q: How do I set a password?
items.a: There is no password. Enter your email, we send you a sign-in link, and opening it signs you in.

items.q: Who can see my Customer Support questions?
items.a: Only you and Odyssey Ventures staff. Others see them on the board only as a private post.
It is in preparation. Sign up for launch news on the Membership page and we'll tell you first.
